scenarios.title: A｜正常入住
scenarios.setting: 在“正常办理入住”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“正常入住”。

turns.text: Good afternoon. Welcome to the Grand Park Hotel. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想办理入住、出行或离店手续，会怎样说明来意？

choices.text: Hi, I’d like to check in, please.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to check in, please.
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Hi, I’m here to check in.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’m here to check in.
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Hi, I have a reservation. I’d like to check in.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I have a reservation. I’d like to check in.
feedback.explanation: “check in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Hi, I want to do check-in.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I’d like to check in, please.
feedback.explanation: 办理手续直接用动词短语“check in / check out”，不需要再加“do”；带连字符的形式更常作名词或修饰语。

turns.text: Certainly. May I have the name on the reservation?

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. It’s under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. It’s under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: The reservation is under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: The reservation is under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: It’s Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: 接着上文说明对象的具体情况，指代清楚时无需重复完整名称。

choices.text: I booked it by Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. It’s under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: 登记在某人名下用“under + 姓名”；“by Alex Chen”通常表示由这个人完成预订。

turns.text: Thank you, Miss/Mr. Chen. I found your reservation. You’re staying with us for three nights, is that correct?

turns.prompt: 你想确认信息或告诉对方已经完成，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, that’s correct.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, that’s correct.
feedback.explanation: “that’s correct”确认对方复述的信息无误，让对方可以继续办理或安排。

choices.text: Yes, I’ll be staying for three nights.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’ll be staying for three nights.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: That’s right. I’m checking out on Friday.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s right. I’m checking out on Friday.
feedback.explanation: “checking out”在酒店表示办理退房；用这个短语交代手续，比只说要离开更具体。

choices.text: Yes, I stay three nights.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, that’s correct.
feedback.explanation: 描述本次预定停留可说“I’m staying for three nights”；“I stay”更像日常习惯。

turns.text: Great. May I see your passport or ID, please?

turns.prompt: 对方需要查看资料或物品，你会怎样配合？

choices.text: Sure. Here you go.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Here you go.
feedback.explanation: “here you go”递交或展示物品时使用，让对方知道所需东西已经准备好。

choices.text: Of course. Here’s my passport.

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. Here’s my passport.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Yes, just a moment. Here it is.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, just a moment. Here it is.
feedback.explanation: “here it is”递交或展示物品时使用，让对方知道所需东西已经准备好。

choices.text: Yes, this is.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Here you go.
feedback.explanation: “Yes, this is”没有完整说明对象；递交物品可直接用“Here you go”，对方就知道你在配合。

turns.text: Thank you. Everything looks good. Here’s your key card. You’re in room 806 on the eighth floor.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: Thank you. What time is breakfast?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. What time is breakfast?
feedback.explanation: “What time”请对方给出具体时点，适合确认开始、结束或赴约时间。

choices.text: Thanks. Where is the elevator?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. Where is the elevator?
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Great. Is Wi-Fi available in the room?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Is Wi-Fi available in the room?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: Thank you. Where I can find the elevator?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. What time is breakfast?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要疑问语序：将“can / should / will”等放在主语前；若使用实义动词，则根据时态补上“do / does / did”。

turns.text: Breakfast is from 6:30 to 10 a.m. on the second floor. The elevators are just around the corner, and the Wi-Fi information is on your key card holder.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great, thank you for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thank you for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Perfect. Thanks. Have a nice day.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thanks. Have a nice day.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Got it. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

turns.text: You’re welcome. Enjoy your stay.

scenarios.title: B｜需要填写入住信息
scenarios.setting: 在“正常办理入住”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“需要填写入住信息”。

turns.text: Welcome to the Grand Park Hotel. Are you checking in?

turns.prompt: 向对方提供登记所需的姓名，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, I have a reservation under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I have a reservation under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: Yes, I’d like to check in. The reservation is under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’d like to check in. The reservation is under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: Yes, I’m checking in. My name is Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’m checking in. My name is Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “checking in”表示办理入住或值机等登记手续，具体含义由当前场景决定。

choices.text: Yes, I have booked in Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I have a reservation under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: 预订在某人名下用“under”，不是“in”；也可直接说“I have a reservation under …”。

turns.text: I’ve found your reservation. Before we check you in, could you please fill out this registration form?

turns.prompt: 你想了解入住登记需要填写哪些信息，会怎么说？

choices.text: Sure. What information do I need to provide?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. What information do I need to provide?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Of course. What do I need to fill in?

feedback.naturalExpression: Of course. What do I need to fill in?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Sure. Do I need to fill out everything on the form?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. Do I need to fill out everything on the form?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: What information I need to write?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. What information do I need to provide?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要疑问语序：将“can / should / will”等放在主语前；若使用实义动词，则根据时态补上“do / does / did”。

turns.text: We’ll need your full name, home address, phone number, and signature.

turns.prompt: 你想确认入住登记是否需要护照资料，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Do I need to provide my passport number as well?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Do I need to provide my passport number as well?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Do you also need my passport details?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you also need my passport details?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: Should I put my passport number here?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I put my passport number here?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Do you need my passport numbers?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Do I need to provide my passport number as well?
feedback.explanation: 这里询问的是一本护照的编号，通常用单数“passport number”；只有多本护照才需复数。

turns.text: Yes, please. You can enter it in this section.

turns.prompt: 你想确认入住表格上应在哪里签字，会怎么说？

choices.text: All right. And where should I sign?

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. And where should I sign?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Where do I need to sign?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where do I need to sign?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Do I sign at the bottom?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I sign at the bottom?
feedback.explanation: “do I sign”询问签名位置或是否需要签名，适合操作前作确认。

choices.text: Where I should sign my name?

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. And where should I sign?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要疑问语序：将“can / should / will”等放在主语前；若使用实义动词，则根据时态补上“do / does / did”。

turns.text: Right here at the bottom of the form.

turns.prompt: 对方需要查看资料或物品，你会怎样配合？

choices.text: Okay, I’ve filled it out. Here you go.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ve filled it out. Here you go.
feedback.explanation: “here you go”递交或展示物品时使用，让对方知道所需东西已经准备好。

choices.text: All done. Here’s the form.

feedback.naturalExpression: All done. Here’s the form.
feedback.explanation: “all done”表示已经完成，适合在填表或操作后简短告知对方。

choices.text: I think that’s everything. Could you check it for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: I think that’s everything. Could you check it for me?
feedback.explanation: “that’s everything”表示目前没有其他需求，适合结束一次服务问答。

choices.text: Okay, I finished to fill it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ve filled it out. Here you go.
feedback.explanation: “finish”后接动作时用 -ing 形式；表格“填写完成”也可说“I’ve filled it out”。

turns.text: Thank you. Let me check… Everything looks fine.

turns.prompt: 你想确认入住材料是否已经齐全，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Is there anything else you need from me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Is there anything else you need from me?
feedback.explanation: 主动询问还有哪些选择，原方案行不通时仍能继续商量。

choices.text: Perfect. Do you need anything else?

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Do you need anything else?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Okay. Is that everything?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Is that everything?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: Do I need give you something else?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Is there anything else you need from me?
feedback.explanation: “need”后接动作时通常用“need to + 动词原形”。补上“to”，才能把“需要”和具体动作连接起来。

turns.text: No, that’s all. Here’s your key card. You’re in room 806.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you very much.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you very much.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Great, thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Perfect. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: C｜需要支付押金 / 信用卡预授权
scenarios.setting: 在“正常办理入住”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“需要支付押金 / 信用卡预授权”。

turns.text: Everything is ready for your check-in. We just need a credit card for the security deposit.

turns.prompt: 你想了解这项服务的费用，会怎么问？

choices.text: How much is the deposit?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much is the deposit?
feedback.explanation: “deposit”指押金或订金，具体是否退还需看当前安排。

choices.text: Could you tell me how much the deposit is?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me how much the deposit is?
feedback.explanation: “deposit”指押金或订金，具体是否退还需看当前安排。

choices.text: How much will you hold on my card?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much will you hold on my card?
feedback.explanation: “hold on my card”谈的是解除银行卡上的冻结额度，需与已经实际扣款后退款区分。

choices.text: How much deposit I need to pay?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much is the deposit?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要疑问语序：将“can / should / will”等放在主语前；若使用实义动词，则根据时态补上“do / does / did”。

turns.text: It’s $200. We’ll place a temporary hold on your credit card.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: So you’re not actually charging my card right now?

feedback.naturalExpression: So you’re not actually charging my card right now?
feedback.explanation: “not actually”澄清实际情况与表面理解的差别，适合核对容易误解的信息。

choices.text: Is it a charge, or just a hold on my card?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it a charge, or just a hold on my card?
feedback.explanation: “hold on my card”谈的是解除银行卡上的冻结额度，需与已经实际扣款后退款区分。

choices.text: So the $200 is only temporarily held?

feedback.naturalExpression: So the $200 is only temporarily held?
feedback.explanation: “temporarily held”表示暂时冻结或保留，强调这不是最终处理结果。

choices.text: So you don’t take the $200 from my card?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: So you’re not actually charging my card right now?
feedback.explanation: 这句能询问是否扣钱；“charge my card”是更具体的金融说法，便于区分扣款和预授权。

choices.text: So you will not charge my card money?

feedback.naturalExpression: So you’re not actually charging my card right now?
feedback.explanation: 银行卡扣款用“charge my card”，不在后面直接再加“money”；需要金额时可以另说明具体数额。

turns.text: That’s right. It’s only a pre-authorization. The amount won’t actually be charged unless there are additional expenses or damage to the room.

turns.prompt: 你想确认款项何时退回或解除冻结，会怎么问？

choices.text: When will the hold be released?

feedback.naturalExpression: When will the hold be released?
feedback.explanation: “hold be released”谈的是解除银行卡上的冻结额度，需与已经实际扣款后退款区分。

choices.text: How long will it take for the money to be released?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long will it take for the money to be released?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: When will the $200 become available again?

feedback.naturalExpression: When will the $200 become available again?
feedback.explanation: “available”指可获得或可使用的；询问服务时常指有没有余位。

choices.text: When can I get my $200 back?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: When will the hold be released?
feedback.explanation: 这句能问钱何时回来；若只是押金预授权，应问“when the hold will be released”，区分解除冻结和退款。

choices.text: When you will return my deposit?

feedback.naturalExpression: When will the hold be released?
feedback.explanation: 直接提问需要疑问语序：将“can / should / will”等放在主语前；若使用实义动词，则根据时态补上“do / does / did”。

turns.text: We release the hold when you check out, but it may take a few business days for your bank to process it.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, I understand. Can I use this card?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I understand. Can I use this card?
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: That’s fine. Here’s my credit card.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s fine. Here’s my credit card.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: No problem. You can use this card for the deposit.

feedback.naturalExpression: No problem. You can use this card for the deposit.
feedback.explanation: “deposit”指押金或订金，具体是否退还需看当前安排。

choices.text: Okay, you can take this card.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I understand. Can I use this card?
feedback.explanation: “take this card”可能被理解为把卡拿走；确认付款方式应说“use this card”。

turns.text: Certainly. Please insert your card here.

turns.prompt: 你想确认刷卡预授权时下一步如何操作，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do I need to enter my PIN?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to enter my PIN?
feedback.explanation: “Do I need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: Should I enter my PIN now?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I enter my PIN now?
feedback.explanation: “PIN”指个人识别码，通常指银行卡等使用的数字密码。

choices.text: Do you need me to do anything else?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you need me to do anything else?
feedback.explanation: “do you need”确认对方需要哪些信息或物品，能避免自行猜测办理要求。

choices.text: Do I need input my password?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do I need to enter my PIN?
feedback.explanation: “need”后需要“to”，刷卡时输入的数字密码通常叫“PIN”，不是泛指账户登录的“password”。

turns.text: No, just leave the card in for a moment… All right, it’s been approved.

turns.prompt: 你想取得付款凭证，会怎样提出请求？

choices.text: Great. Could I get a receipt for that?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could I get a receipt for that?
feedback.explanation: “receipt”指收据或付款小票，是交易凭证。

choices.text: Could you give me a receipt, please?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you give me a receipt, please?
feedback.explanation: “receipt”指收据或付款小票，是交易凭证。

choices.text: Will the deposit appear on my receipt?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will the deposit appear on my receipt?
feedback.explanation: “receipt”指收据或付款小票，是交易凭证。

choices.text: Can you give me the paper of this payment?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Could I get a receipt for that?
feedback.explanation: “paper of this payment”不是常用名称；直接索要“receipt”就能说明需要付款凭证。

turns.text: Of course. Here’s your receipt and your room key. You’re in room 806.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. Thank you for explaining that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Thank you for explaining that.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Great, thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Thank you. I understand now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I understand now.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

turns.text: You’re welcome. Enjoy your stay.
